violations.title: Cold Holding

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours

Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TIME AND DISCARD UNUSED POTATOES AT 3:30PM. DON CHURRO CAFE (Inspection Date: 12/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures

violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED COOKED POTATOES AT 98F AFTER 2.5 HOURS IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP (LEFT).
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE USE SHALLOW PANS OR TRAYS IN THE REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER TO COOL FOODS FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F IN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. DO NOT PLACE HOT FOODS IN PREP TOPS. FOODS SHOULD BE COOLED TO 41F BEFORE TRANSFERRING TO PREP TOPS.

violations.title: Cold Holding

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED CHEMICALS STORED ON SHELVING WITH FOODS ITEMS IN STORAGE HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS TO CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name: CHEMICALS IN SQUEEZE BOTTLES IN BAR AREA WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY LABLES DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SYRUP AND EGG WHITE WITHOUT LABELS IN BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY LABLES DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: FLOUR, BEANS, OIL STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE FOODS FROM FLOOR.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the END OF COOK LINE is blocked, WITH FOOD CART preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED FOOD CART DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELLED EGGS ABOVED COOKED GROUND BEEF AND CONTAINER OF CHICHA BEVERAGE IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.
